jobs.title: Software Engineering Intern
bullets: Improved reliability of Excel Copilot's auditing skill by investigating bugs and overhauling the data ingestion pipeline, skill architecture, and output validation logic, increasing error detection consistency by 15%.
Built automated agent evals to measure error detection and output formatting using custom LLM-checklist grading criteria, replacing ad hoc testing and reducing evaluation time by 60%.
Refactored the Excel agent's telemetry pipeline by consolidating 4 Kusto tables into a single compact table capturing the full lifecycle of a Copilot query, reducing query time from 15 minutes to 5s.

jobs.title: Software Engineering Intern
bullets: Implemented an asynchronous notification pipeline handling 100+ weekly email reclassification checks, introducing distributed caching and atomic compare-and-swap to prevent race conditions and eliminate duplicate notifications.

Architected a dedicated synchronous Go microservice for phishing mailbox connections, isolating it from the existing async architecture to eliminate silent failures that left mailboxes stalled for hours or days, reducing customer-reported support tickets.
Developed a secure email body viewer in Python, implementing backend filtering to surface only safe emails within a 30-day window, ensuring no unsafe content was exposed to the frontend.

jobs.title: Software Engineering Intern

Launched a debit repayment workflow by developing Flask services with PostgreSQL for secure transaction handling.

jobs.title: AI Software Developer Intern
bullets: Built a full-stack file management system using Next.js and Typescript with Firestore and Firebase Cloud Storage, featuring RBAC, JWT authentication and secure APIs for sensitive merger and acquisition (M&A) documents.

Designed and implemented a document classification pipeline to categorize financial, legal, and tax documents, using text classification and logistic regression models with TF-IDF feature extraction, achieving a classification accuracy rate of 90%.

jobs.title: Software Engineering Intern

Optimized backend infrastructure by applying promise-based asynchronous programming and data caching strategies to efficiently serve high-volume RESTful API requests, improving scalability and reducing response times by 30%.

jobs.title: Software Developer Intern
